label: Controls for reflexive defeat, a retained basis, alternative support and bare error
paraphrase: Four stipulated interpretations. The policy and its self-application premises can hold with a true unwarranted target. They can instead diverge at the policy despite a warranted report and a varying verdict. An undercut basis can coexist with warranted target content through other support. An actually incorrect constant verdict can coexist with the report, the policy and an undefeated basis.
